extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent practitioners, and USPTO examiners handling applications with nucleotide/amino acid sequence disclosures (biotechnology filings)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and procedural requirements for preparing, submitting, amending, and responding to Office notices concerning Sequence Listing XML (WIPO ST.26) parts of patent applications filed on or after July 1, 2022, that disclose nucleotide and/or amino acid sequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability date and coverage (ST.26 requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: For applications (including national stage and reissue) having a filing date, or international filing date for national stage, on or after July 1, 2022, disclosures of one or more nucleotide and/or amino acid sequences as defined in 37 CFR 1.831(b) must include a Sequence Listing XML as a separate part of the specification (i.e., must comply with 37 CFR 1.831 through 1.835).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This applies even if the new application claims benefit/priority to earlier applications filed before July 1, 2022 (continuations, CIPs, provisionals where applicable, PCT national stage under 35 U.S.C. 371, reissue filed on/after July 1, 2022). Determine applicability by the filing or international filing date as described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence Listing XML format and content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Sequence Listing must be provided in XML (WIPO Standard ST.26) in accordance with the symbols and format requirements of 37 CFR 1.831-1.834.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The XML must present sequences and associated information using the ST.26 format and conform to the specific element/attribute rules in §§1.832–1.834 (i.e., the separate 'Sequence Listing XML' part of disclosure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted submission media and upload limits
rubrics_metrics.description: A compliant Sequence Listing XML must be submitted either via the USPTO patent electronic filing system (Patent Center) as an XML file or on a read-only optical disc in compliance with 37 CFR 1.52(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Currently XML files can only be submitted via Patent Center; if the Sequence Listing XML file exceeds Patent Center upload limits, it must be submitted on a read-only optical disc. Read-only disc submissions must comply with 1.52(e) labeling and delivery rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation-by-reference paragraph in specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Any amendment adding an initial Sequence Listing XML or a replacement Sequence Listing XML must include a request to amend the specification to incorporate by reference the material in the XML file and identify the file name, date of creation, and size in bytes (see 37 CFR 1.835(a)(2) and 1.835(b)(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The incorporation-by-reference must be placed in a separate paragraph of the specification (or follow 1.52(e) requirements for discs) and the substitute specification must be filed in accordance with 37 CFR 1.52, 1.121(b)(3), and 1.125 when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of basis for amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: An amendment that adds an initial Sequence Listing XML must include a statement indicating the basis for the amendment with specific references to particular parts of the application as originally filed (specification, claims, drawings) for all sequence data (37 CFR 1.835(a)(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The statement should identify paragraphs or drawing sheets where the sequences were originally disclosed and, for replacements or edits, identify the specific sequences being added/modified and their original locations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement that Sequence Listing XML contains no new matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Any submission adding or replacing a Sequence Listing XML must include a statement that the Sequence Listing XML includes no new matter (37 CFR 1.835(a)(4) and 1.835(b)(5)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is required for initial additions and replacements; applicant must affirm the content does not introduce subject matter beyond the original disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replacement Sequence Listing XML must be complete and identify changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Any amendment adding to, deleting from, or replacing sequence information must submit a replacement Sequence Listing XML that contains the entire Sequence Listing (including all additions, deletions, or replacements) and include a statement that identifies the location of all additions, deletions, or replacements of sequence information relative to the replaced Sequence Listing XML (37 CFR 1.835(b)(1) and 1.835(b)(3)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The replacement XML is not a patch of only changed entries; it must be the full listing. Also include a statement identifying locations of changed data and a statement that no new matter is introduced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support statement for amended sequence data
rubrics_metrics.description: When submitting additions, deletions, or replacements in a Sequence Listing XML, applicant must include a statement indicating the support for the changes with specific references to parts of the application as originally filed for all amended sequence data (37 CFR 1.835(b)(4) and 1.835(a)(3) analogously).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite paragraphs, claims, or drawing sheets that provide the basis/support for each amended sequence entry to show amendment is within original disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labeling of replacement read-only optical disc
rubrics_metrics.description: A replacement Sequence Listing XML submitted on read-only optical disc must be labeled as “REPLACEMENT MM/DD/YYYY” with the month, day, and year of creation indicated, in compliance with 37 CFR 1.52(e) (see 1.835(b)(1) guidance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow 1.52(e) labeling requirements for disc submissions to ensure correct processing and record retention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation of Sequence Listing XML is not an amendment (language-dependent free text)
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing an English translation of a previously submitted Sequence Listing XML that contains non-English values for language-dependent free text elements is not considered an amended Sequence Listing XML for purposes of complying with paragraphs (a) through (c) of 1.835, provided the translated Sequence Listing XML complies with §§1.831-1.834 (37 CFR 1.835(d)(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updated values for root element attributes or general information elements (as specified) are not considered amendments; translations must be compliant ST.26 XML. If non-English text exists in INSDQualifier_value elements, either include English text or submit a translation.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT/international applications: invitation to furnish and late furnishing fee
rubrics_metrics.description: If a PCT international application to be searched/examined by the US ISA/IPEA does not satisfy §§1.831–1.834 at filing, the applicant may be invited (PCT Rule 13ter) to furnish a Sequence Listing XML within a prescribed time; the Sequence Listing XML must be accompanied by a statement that it does not go beyond the disclosure in the international application as filed and payment of the late furnishing fee under 37 CFR 1.445(a)(5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicant fails to timely provide it, the ISA/IPEA will search/examine only to the extent a meaningful search/examination can be performed without the Sequence Listing. A proper response includes the XML in ST.26, the late fee, and the non-beyond-disclosure statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provisional application rules for sequence disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisional applications are not required to include a separate sequence listing, but if a provisional filed on or after July 1, 2022 includes a separate sequence listing it must be submitted as a Sequence Listing XML compliant with §§1.831–1.834. Provisional applications cannot be amended, so a non-compliant Sequence Listing XML in a provisional will not generate a notice in that provisional application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because provisionals are not amendable, consider submitting compliant XML at filing if relying on the provisional for later claims/filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improper ASCII .txt Sequence Listing submissions when XML required and available relief
rubrics_metrics.description: If an applicant mistakenly submits an ASCII .txt Sequence Listing in an application filed on or after July 1, 2022 when a Sequence Listing XML is required, the earlier .txt listing may be used to support a compliant Sequence Listing XML only in limited circumstances (e.g., relying on 37 CFR 1.57(b) if a prior filed application contains a compliant Sequence Listing present on its filing date, or via a grantable petition under 37 CFR 1.182 if no proper benefit/priority claim exists).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relief under 1.57(b) requires a compliant earlier listing in an application to which proper benefit/priority is claimed and that the earlier listing was present on that filing date. A petition under 1.182 requires showing the ASCII listing's sequence information and submitting a compliant Sequence Listing XML plus statements that no new matter is introduced; any ASCII .txt listing relied on will be retained in the record for retention purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for a petition or response relying on an earlier Sequence Listing
rubrics_metrics.description: When relying on an earlier Sequence Listing (e.g., under 1.57(b)) or filing a petition under 1.182 to justify a later-submitted compliant Sequence Listing XML, applicant must submit: (1) a compliant Sequence Listing XML; (2) a statement identifying where the omitted portion can be found (e.g., identifying nucleotide/amino acid sequence information in the earlier listing); (3) identification of the sequences relied upon; (4) a statement that the Sequence Listing XML does not introduce new matter; and (5) a statement that the portion was inadvertently omitted if claiming 1.57(b) relief.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Availability of relief under 1.57(b) precludes filing a grantable petition under 1.182 seeking the same relief. Ensure all required statements and citations to the earlier filed material are precise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-examination and examiner identification duties
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-examination staff and examiners must identify whether an application disclosing sequences requires a Sequence Listing XML and whether a compliant Sequence Listing XML is present; if missing or non-compliant, they must issue a notice indicating deficiencies and may use an OPAP Routing Sheet (Document Code 'SEQREQ') to return the application to pre-examination for mailing a notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiners should explain why a Sequence Listing XML is required when using deficiency form paragraphs and follow the procedural flow for returning to pre-examination when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required applicant response materials for deficiency notices (substitute specification and XML)
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to notices requiring an initial or replacement Sequence Listing XML, applicant must provide a compliant (replacement) Sequence Listing XML and a substitute specification inserting the incorporation-by-reference paragraph; the substitute specification must include: a marked-up version (deletions strike-through/brackets, insertions underlined), a clean version, and a statement that the substitute specification contains no new matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Responses must also include required supporting statements (basis for amendment, statements of no new matter, identification of locations of additions/deletions for replacements, and statements of support). Follow 37 CFR 1.52, 1.121(b)(3), and 1.125 for substitute specification filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form ¶24.18.26 — No 'Sequence Listing XML' deficiency and required responses
rubrics_metrics.description: When the application fails to contain a Sequence Listing XML as required by 37 CFR 1.831–1.834, the specific deficiency form ¶24.18.26 is used and requires applicant to provide: a Sequence Listing XML (as per allowed submission media), a statement indicating the basis for the amendment with references to the original filing, a statement that no new matter is included, and a substitute specification (marked-up, clean, and a statement of no new matter).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner must precede this form paragraph with ¶24.17.26 and should explain why the XML is required. This paragraph may be followed by additional deficiency paragraphs as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form ¶24.19.26 — Defective 'Sequence Listing XML' deficiency and required responses
rubrics_metrics.description: If a filed Sequence Listing XML is defective, damaged, or unreadable, form ¶24.19.26 is used and requires applicant to provide a replacement Sequence Listing XML, a statement identifying the location of all additions/deletions/replacements relative to the replaced XML (37 CFR 1.835(b)(3)), a statement indicating support for the replacement in the application as filed (37 CFR 1.835(b)(4)), a statement that the replacement includes no new matter (37 CFR 1.835(b)(5)), and a substitute specification (marked-up and clean) inserting the incorporation-by-reference paragraph.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This paragraph is used when a defective XML was filed and a notice was sent identifying errors. It may be used when applicant provides a disc in reply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form ¶24.20.26 — 'Sequence Listing XML' contains STIC-reported errors and required responses
rubrics_metrics.description: When a Sequence Listing XML has errors according to the STIC report, form ¶24.20.26 requires the applicant to submit a replacement Sequence Listing XML, statements identifying locations of additions/deletions/replacements, a statement indicating support for the amendment as filed, a statement that the replacement contains no new matter, and a substitute specification (marked-up and clean) inserting the incorporation-by-reference paragraph.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when STIC indicates errors; follow same substitute specification and statement requirements as other deficiency responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence identifiers requirement in specification and drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequences that appear in the specification or drawings must be identified by sequence identifiers (e.g., 'SEQ ID NO:X' or the like) in accordance with 37 CFR 1.831(c); sequence identifiers must appear either in the drawings or in the Brief Description of the Drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If sequence IDs are missing, required response is amended drawings in accordance with 37 CFR 1.121(d) inserting identifiers and/or a substitute specification inserting required sequence identifiers. Provide marked-up and clean specification copies and a statement that the substitute contains no new matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record retention of improperly-submitted ASCII Sequence Listings
rubrics_metrics.description: If an ASCII plain text Sequence Listing was erroneously submitted, that ASCII filing will be retained in the official record for the application for record retention purposes even if a compliant Sequence Listing XML is later submitted or relied upon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and examiners should be aware that the ASCII file remains in the file history; compliance remedy steps (1.57(b) or 1.182 petition) are available only under the described circumstances.
